name_note: Nearly all genomes placed here by GTDB correspond to NCBI Akkermansia, the genus of the classical literature species Akkermansia muciniphila.

sentences.text: Akkermansia muciniphila is a Gram-negative, strictly anaerobic, oval-shaped bacterium of the division Verrucomicrobia.
It was isolated from faeces, and is described as a mucin-degrading bacterium that resides in the mucus layer.
It grows on mucin as sole carbon and nitrogen source and on a few sugars such as N-acetylglucosamine and glucose when protein is supplied.

Studies have reported a negative correlation between Akkermansia muciniphila abundance and overweight, obesity or untreated type 2 diabetes, and Akkermansia has been reported negatively associated with T2D.
